title: Contact networks encode the ATP-induced dynamic structural asymmetry of condensin head domains.
one_liner_zh: 该文用粗粒化Go模型与全原子MD研究凝缩蛋白头部ATP诱导的构象不对称性，虽涉及蛋白-DNA互作相关SMC复合物，但核心是ATP结合而非TF-DNA结合，方法可迁移但对象偏离。
abstract: Condensin, a structural maintenance of chromosomes (SMC) complex, plays a central role in genome organization by driving DNA loop extrusion through ATP hydrolysis. Experimental studies have revealed an asymmetric ATP-binding order at the Smc4- and Smc2-linked head domains, but the molecular origin and temperature dependence of this asymmetry remain poorly understood. Here, we combine coarse-grained switching-Go models with all-atom molecular dynamics simulations to investigate how contact-network architecture in ATP-like states governs the order and thermal sensitivity of ATP-competent pocket formation. We find that the Smc4-associated ATP pocket (ATP1) exhibits higher local contact density and greater thermal stability than the Smc2-associated pocket (ATP2), favoring initial ATP1 pocket formation. As temperature increases, the formation of ATP2-binding-competent conformations becomes increasingly dependent on prior ATP1 pocket organization. Contact-network analysis of ATP-induced conformational transitions identifies specific structural regions that mediate this thermodynamic shift, revealing a temperature-dependent shift from independent to sequential pocket formation, consistent with the experimentally observed ATP-binding order at the two head sites. All-atom simulations provide supporting evidence that ATP1 pockets are highly persistent when the nucleotide is present but destabilize upon removal, whereas ATP2 pockets show greater intrinsic pre-organization in the ATP-absent state yet are less persistent when bound than ATP1 pockets. Together, these results advance a thermodynamic framework showing how contact-network connectivity encodes asymmetric, temperature-sensitive conformational competence for nucleotide engagement in condensin.
abstract_zh: 凝缩蛋白（Condensin）是一种染色体结构维持（SMC）复合物，通过ATP水解驱动DNA环挤压，在基因组组织中发挥核心作用。实验研究揭示了Smc4和Smc2连接头部结构域处ATP结合顺序的不对称性，但这种不对称性的分子起源及其温度依赖性仍知之甚少。在此，我们结合粗粒化开关-Go模型与全原子分子动力学模拟，研究ATP样状态下的接触网络架构如何调控ATP胜任口袋形成的顺序和热敏感性。我们发现，与Smc2相关的ATP口袋（ATP2）相比，Smc4相关的ATP口袋（ATP1）表现出更高的局部接触密度和更大的热稳定性，有利于ATP1口袋的初始形成。随着温度升高，ATP2结合胜任构象的形成越来越依赖于先前ATP1口袋的组织。对ATP诱导构象转变的接触网络分析识别出介导这一热力学转变的特定结构区域，揭示了从独立口袋形成到顺序口袋形成的温度依赖性转变，与实验观察到的两个头部位点ATP结合顺序一致。全原子模拟提供了支持性证据，表明当核苷酸存在时ATP1口袋高度持久，但去除后失稳，而ATP2口袋在ATP缺失状态下表现出更大的内在预组织，但结合时持久性低于ATP1口袋。综合这些结果，我们推进了一个热力学框架，展示了接触网络连接性如何编码凝缩蛋白中核苷酸参与的不对称、温度敏感的构象胜任性。
